code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, metabolic acidosis, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, INR, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and impaired oxygenation, which may be seen in severe infection (e.g., viral pneumonia), sepsis, or other critical illness. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
